parsed.rationale: I can't agree this ECG is normal: the QRS is wide, V1–V2 show a tall RSR' (rsR') pattern with ST depression and T-wave inversion, and leads I, V5 and V6 have broad slurred S waves, all with a fast rhythm of about 150 bpm, which fits right bundle branch block, and there is no ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria.
